notes: These are the declared study values, not the demonstration defaults in src/config.py; see README.md, section 'Reproducing the published values'.
The data block matches the released R1 snapshot described in data_schema.md. run_demo.py without --data-dir uses a smaller 120-household, 24-month smoke panel instead.

Baseline detectors select their threshold at task_c.tolerance_months and are scored there; MU-CARF selects its threshold at the one-month endpoint and MU-CARF rows are scored at tolerance 1. Rows must not be compared across tolerances.
The CUSUM comparator uses fixed parameters instead of a development-set threshold search.
